name: roslyn-lsp
description: Solution-aware Microsoft Roslyn LSP via ClaudeCodeRoslynLspProxy

telemetry_level.title: Roslyn telemetry level
telemetry_level.description: Forwarded to Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.LanguageServer as --telemetryLevel. Allowed: off | error | crash | all. Defaults to 'off' so nothing is sent to Microsoft unless you opt in.

log_level.title: Roslyn log level
log_level.description: Forwarded to Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.LanguageServer as --logLevel. Allowed: Trace | Debug | Information | Warning | Error | Critical. Defaults to 'Information'.
